positions.title: Software Development Engineer II
positions.locationName: Jersey City, New Jersey, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
- Fintech Payments Last Mile team, responsible for distributing hundreds of billions of dollars a year (almost half a trillion) to various vendors, employees, government entities, etc.
- Completely migrated over and modernized all of our existing infrastructure from LPT to IaaC via CDK across 40+ pipelines and 9 different partner banks. Reduced number of pipelines by 75% and streamlined approach to deployments, making engineer lives easier with significant time savings of up to 75% per deployment.
- Led and designed data replication project to accurately and timely replicate and store all of our internal data from DynamoDB to PostgreSQL across hundreds of millions of rows.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Responsible for job scheduler platform running millions of AV simulations per day by farming work out to thousands of workers (VM Instances)
- Led and designed a custom Quotas scheduling system, allowing users to avoid resource contention amongst the entire company, speeding up critical jobs turnaround time improving customer satisfaction 
- Implemented tiered workers - intelligently spinning up vm instances according to estimated need based off� of historical results, resulting in savings of 30k/mo
- Designed and created a custom estimation service responsible for generating estimates of simulation runtimes; estimates were accurate within +/- 18% across millions of tasks and allowed for completion goal based scheduling
- Responsible for the transfer and cleanup of over 30Pb of existing data resulting in over 100k/mo. savings and cleanup of over 1Pb of additional data per day resulting in over 15k/mo. savings

positions.title: Lead Tutor
positions.description: Tutored hundreds of students by holding office hours through elucidating important fundamental concepts, helping to lead them through challenging programming assignments and homework. Responsible for leading in person discussions, online discussions and was responsible for grading both assignments and exams. Also in charge of leading other tutors in managing their responsibilities and facilitating communication between them and the Professor.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern II
positions.description:
Designed, implemented and tested a test and evaluation environment in support of an orbital, high data rate optical communication transceiver set in space

In charge of coding up and testing API’s in support of previously mentioned communication transceiver as well as documenting the entire process

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern I
positions.description:
Designed and implemented file management program in order to solve company problem of mismanaged documents; applied company-wide by IT to over 100 computers and 3 million files total

Wrote tests contributing to quality assurance of CubeSat space processor including memory corruption test to ensure processor’s continued functionality after exposure to high levels of radiation

positions.title: Avionics Member
positions.description:
Member of 3 million dollars NASA sponsored CubeSat team working on sending 6-unit satellite into lunar orbit in 2018. 
In charge of integrating and testing sensors aboard CubeSat including Star Tracker, Thermocouples, IMU, etc.

company.name: Students for the Exploration and Development of Space (SEDS)

positions.title: Tutor
positions.description:
Tutored dozens of students seeking help by holding office hours in core computer science class through elucidating important fundamental concepts, helping to lead them through challenging programming assignments 
Reviewed lecture and text material before every office hour session, ensuring full ability to impart knowledge of complex material onto students accurately and responsibly

positions.title: Developer
positions.description: Responsible for developing company's main product. Allows users to create, publish, and share mobile games straight from their Phone. (gamebuilder.io)

positions.title: Lab Intern
positions.description: Handled production of entire product line through treating cell cultures that were sold to company’s client base and tasked with responsibility of addressing technical issues; successfully resolving company-wide virus problems

positions.title: Summer Instructor
positions.description: Mentored class of underprivileged 5th graders, helping increase English proficiency to standard 6th grade level. Cultivated their passion for learning the English language through activities like playing games and putting on plays. Designed and developed comprehensive lesson plans to inspire a passion for learning English amongst students

courses.name: Basic Data Structures and Object-Oriented Design

volunteerExperiences.description: Served as a volunteer for the Taiwanese Tzu-Shao organization and participated in activities including feeding the homeless, preparing complimentary meals to families living at Ronald McDonald's House and teaching math and writing to students in disadvantaged communities.

projects.title: AptOrganizer
projects.description:
Completely self created a web application that allows users to create rooms to share with apartment-mates in order to log what items to bring along with who is bringing them

Designed and implemented storing to and querying from online database; unique shareable Room ID’s; unique user identifiers

projects.title: Spelling System
projects.description: Created a program to aid in everyday coursework by adding previously non-existent functions in association with text editors.
